name: oneplugin-obsidian
description: An all-in-one Obsidian plugin to help users organise their lives.

scripts.test: npm run test:markdb && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:markdb: node --import jiti/register tests/markdb/errors.test.ts && node --import jiti/register tests/markdb/core.test.ts && node --import jiti/register tests/markdb/backends.test.ts
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
